title: persea surinamensis
intro: Persea surinamensis, commonly known as West Indian bay, is a plant species native to Central and South America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Persea surinamensis include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-ulcerative properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds such as alkaloids and phenolic acids.
